about: With over 15 million games sold worldwide, the "Crazy Chicken" is one of the most widely-known and memorable videogame characters. It's time to join in on the fun!

It's hunting season! Find the crazy chickens in the Scottish Highlands: Load your gun, take aim and be quick on the trigger to gun down all the birds as they fly by. The harder they are to hit, the more points you get for a shot.
The remake of the cult hit. Rip-roaring shooting fun with the craziest and most infamous chicken in the world!
• The beloved classic, now remastered • Single-player mode: Bag as many chickens as possible in 90 seconds!
• 1-on-1 duel: Who can pluck more chickens from the sky?
